title_working: The Debt That Doubled Every Night
world_rule: The Debt That Doubled Every Night

lines.text: In this town, every coin you borrowed doubled every night.
lines.say: (worried) In this town, every coin you borrowed doubled every night.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: A golden coin duplicates on a desk at midnight as Kaito watches in horror.

lines.text: And if you couldn't pay… the bank took something you could never get back.
lines.say: (nervous) And if you couldn't pay… the bank took something you could never get back.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Kaito turns toward the massive ringing bank clocktower looming over the town.

lines.text: BLACKTHORN BANK
lines.say: (serious) BLACKTHORN BANK
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Citizens line up outside the grand golden bank building in town square.

lines.text: EVERY LOAN DOUBLES AT MIDNIGHT.
lines.say: (confident) EVERY LOAN DOUBLES AT MIDNIGHT.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: A terrifying sign displays the bank's midnight doubling rules.

lines.text: Everyone knew the rule. Borrow ten coins, owe twenty tomorrow. Borrow twenty, owe forty. Nobody questioned the bank because everyone needed money.
lines.say: (worried) Everyone knew the rule. Borrow ten coins, owe twenty tomorrow. Borrow twenty, owe forty. Nobody questioned the bank because everyone needed money.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Poor citizens count their tiny coins while Marcus watches coldly from his balcony.

lines.text: Noah… will I get better soon?
lines.say: (sad) Noah… will I get better soon?
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Mia lies in bed clutching her teddy bear, looking weakly up at Kaito.

lines.text: Of course. I'll find a way. I promise.
lines.say: (confident) Of course. I'll find a way. I promise.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Kaito holds Mia's hand while trying to reassure her with a brave face.

lines.text: My little sister needed medicine. I had only three coins. So I went to the bank.
lines.say: (sad) My little sister needed medicine. I had only three coins. So I went to the bank.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Kaito looks inside his almost empty coin jar with only three coins left.

lines.text: Please. I need ten coins for my sister's medicine.
lines.say: (nervous) Please. I need ten coins for my sister's medicine.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Kaito approaches Marcus's huge desk inside the grand bank main hall.

lines.text: Ten coins today. Twenty tomorrow. Forty the next day. Do you agree?
lines.say: (confident) Ten coins today. Twenty tomorrow. Forty the next day. Do you agree?
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Marcus smiles subtly while explaining the exponential debt terms to Kaito.

lines.text: Yes… just give me the money.
lines.say: (confident) Yes… just give me the money.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Desperate to help his sister, Kaito signs the contract without reading the tiny text.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: At midnight, Kaito's loan balance rapidly multiplies exponentially on the document.

lines.text: WHAT?! I only borrowed ten coins!
lines.say: (angry) WHAT?! I only borrowed ten coins!
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Kaito confronts Marcus in terror as red alarm lights flood the room.

lines.text: You agreed to the terms.
lines.say: (serious) You agreed to the terms.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Marcus sits calmly behind his desk without a single sign of empathy.

lines.text: IF PAYMENT IS IMPOSSIBLE, FUTURE EARNINGS WILL BE CLAIMED.
lines.say: (worried) IF PAYMENT IS IMPOSSIBLE, FUTURE EARNINGS WILL BE CLAIMED.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: A printing machine reveals the fine print stating future earnings will be claimed.

lines.text: Then I discovered the real punishment. The bank wasn't taking people's money. It was taking years of their future earnings.
lines.say: (worried) Then I discovered the real punishment. The bank wasn't taking people's money. It was taking years of their future earnings.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Kaito realizes the bank's ultimate goal is taking decades of people's lives.

lines.text: I borrowed five coins forty years ago. I still haven't finished paying.
lines.say: (sad) I borrowed five coins forty years ago. I still haven't finished paying.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Grandpa steps forward holding an old faded contract from forty years ago.

lines.text: Forty years?!
lines.say: (worried) Forty years?!
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Kaito stares in horror at Grandpa's endless remaining balance statement.

lines.text: I thought I was borrowing money. I was borrowing my future.
lines.say: (sad) I thought I was borrowing money. I was borrowing my future.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Grandpa looks down in grief while Kaito looks around at thousands of trapped contracts.

lines.text: That day, I learned something. Borrowing isn't always wrong. But never borrow without understanding what you'll owe.
lines.say: (confident) That day, I learned something. Borrowing isn't always wrong. But never borrow without understanding what you'll owe.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Morning sun enters the room as Kaito places coins safely into Mia's savings jar.

lines.text: Because sometimes, the smallest loan can cost you the biggest part of your future.
lines.say: (happy) Because sometimes, the smallest loan can cost you the biggest part of your future.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Mia smiles happily and holds Kaito's hand as warm sunlight fills the bedroom.

lines.text: UNDERSTAND THE PRICE BEFORE YOU BORROW.
lines.say: (serious) UNDERSTAND THE PRICE BEFORE YOU BORROW.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The distant bank clock looms over Blackthorn Town with a clear warning on screen.

upload.title: The Debt That Doubled Every Night #Shorts
upload.description:
Noah borrows money from Blackthorn Bank to save his sick sister, only to realize the horrifying truth behind the doubling debt contract.
A cinematic Roblox story about debt, choices, and reading the fine print.
Original animated story. Not affiliated with Roblox or any creator.
#robloxstory #animatedstory #storytime #shorts

owner_text:
THE DEBT THAT DOUBLED EVERY NIGHT
Complete Roblox Cinematic Story Script
Duration: 1:15–1:20
Aspect Ratio: 9:16
Resolution: 1080 × 1920
FPS: 30
Language: English
Narration: First-person, male youthful voice
Visual Style: Cinematic Roblox 3D, expressive characters, dramatic lighting, realistic camera movements.
CHARACTER REFERENCE — KEEP CONSISTENT
1. NOAH — Protagonist
14 years old.
Messy dark brown hair.
Blue hoodie, black pants, white sneakers.
Brown eyes.
Thin build.
Expressions: worried, hopeful, shocked, determined.
2. LILY — Noah's younger sister
8 years old.
Blonde shoulder-length hair.
Pink sweater, blue skirt.
Holds a small teddy bear.
Expressions: innocent, sick, frightened, relieved.
3. MR. VALE — The Banker
50 years old.
Slick black hair.
Expensive black suit, gold tie.
Carries a golden pocket watch.
Expressions: calm, manipulative, confident, eventually shocked.
4. OLD MAN HENRY — The Witness
70 years old.
Gray hair and beard.
Brown coat, old walking stick.
Looks exhausted.
Expressions: regretful, frightened, compassionate.
SCENE 1 — THE HOOK
TIME: 0:00–0:08
LOCATION: Blackthorn Town — Main Street, Midnight.
CAMERA AND ACTION:
Start with an extreme close-up of a golden coin on a wooden table.
A digital clock changes from 11:59 PM to 12:00 AM.
The coin suddenly splits into two identical coins.
Quick zoom out reveals a terrified boy staring at his growing debt.
In the background, a huge bank clock begins ringing.
LIGHTING:
Dark blue moonlight, flickering golden street lamps, sharp shadows.
SFX: Clock ticking, metallic coin duplication, dramatic bass impact.
NARRATOR (NOAH) — urgent, shocked:
"In this town, every coin you borrowed doubled every night. And if you couldn't pay… the bank took something you could never get back."
TRANSITION: Smash cut to the bank's golden sign.
SCENE 2 — THE TOWN RULE
TIME: 0:08–0:19
LOCATION: Blackthorn Town Square — Morning.
CAMERA:
Wide aerial shot showing a wealthy-looking bank surrounded by poor houses.
Citizens line up outside the bank.
A man holds a small bag of coins while looking terrified.
A bank employee stamps a document.
ON-SCREEN TEXT:
"BLACKTHORN BANK"
"EVERY LOAN DOUBLES AT MIDNIGHT."
NARRATOR — mysterious, explanatory:
"Everyone knew the rule. Borrow ten coins, owe twenty tomorrow. Borrow twenty, owe forty. Nobody questioned the bank because everyone needed money."
VISUAL ACTION:
A poor citizen looks at his empty wallet. A wealthy banker watches from a balcony.
SCENE 3 — THE REASON
TIME: 0:19–0:31
LOCATION: Noah's small house — Evening.
LIGHTING: Warm, dim candlelight.
CAMERA:
Medium shot of Noah sitting beside Lily's bed.
Lily is covered with a blanket.
She coughs and holds her teddy bear.
Noah checks an almost empty coin jar.
Close-up: only three coins remain.
LILY — weak, innocent voice:
"Noah… will I get better soon?"
NOAH — trying to smile, but worried:
"Of course. I'll find a way. I promise."
NARRATOR — emotional, quiet:
"My little sister needed medicine. I had only three coins. So I went to the bank."
TRANSITION: Slow fade to the bank entrance.
SCENE 4 — THE LOAN
TIME: 0:31–0:43
LOCATION: Blackthorn Bank — Main Counter.
LIGHTING: Bright golden chandeliers, cold shadows behind the banker.
CAMERA:
Low-angle shot of Mr. Vale sitting behind an enormous wooden desk.
Noah approaches nervously.
Over-the-shoulder shot showing a loan document.
NOAH — desperate:
"Please. I need ten coins for my sister's medicine."
MR. VALE — calm, smiling slightly:
"Ten coins today. Twenty tomorrow. Forty the next day. Do you agree?"
NOAH — confused but desperate:
"Yes… just give me the money."
ACTION:
Mr. Vale slides the contract toward Noah.
Close-up of Noah signing without reading the smaller text.
SCENE 5 — THE DISCOVERY
TIME: 0:43–0:57
LOCATION: Bank — Midnight.
LIGHTING: Red emergency lights, dark blue shadows.
CAMERA:
Extreme close-up of Noah's debt statement.
Show the number changing rapidly:
"10 → 20 → 40 → 80 → 160"
Noah's eyes widen.
He looks at Mr. Vale.
NOAH — panicking:
"WHAT?! I only borrowed ten coins!"
MR. VALE — emotionless:
"You agreed to the terms."
ACTION:
A mechanical machine prints a document.
Close-up reveals a hidden clause:
"IF PAYMENT IS IMPOSSIBLE, FUTURE EARNINGS WILL BE CLAIMED."
NARRATOR — shocked, serious:
"Then I discovered the real punishment. The bank wasn't taking people's money. It was taking years of their future earnings."
SCENE 6 — THE TWIST
TIME: 0:57–1:10
LOCATION: Bank — Hall of Contracts.
LIGHTING: Dim golden light, long shadows.
CAMERA:
An old man approaches Noah.
He holds an old document.
Close-up reveals his name and a remaining balance.
OLD MAN HENRY — trembling, regretful:
"I borrowed five coins forty years ago. I still haven't finished paying."
NOAH — horrified:
"Forty years?!"
OLD MAN HENRY — sad, looking down:
"I thought I was borrowing money. I was borrowing my future."
CAMERA:
Noah looks at the hundreds of contracts on the wall.
His frightened expression changes into determination.
SCENE 7 — THE FINAL MESSAGE
TIME: 1:10–1:20
LOCATION: Noah's house — Sunrise.
CAMERA:
Noah sits beside Lily.
He places the remaining coins into a small savings jar.
Lily smiles and holds his hand.
Cut to the bank's giant clock in the distance.
NARRATOR — calm, sincere, meaningful:
"That day, I learned something. Borrowing isn't always wrong. But never borrow without understanding what you'll owe. Because sometimes, the smallest loan can cost you the biggest part of your future."
FINAL ON-SCREEN TEXT:
"UNDERSTAND THE PRICE BEFORE YOU BORROW."
END.
